_source: docs/sih/SIH26047_Patient_Case_Taking_Software.md, Module A: 'AYUSH history mode: for Ayurvedic OPDs, an extended interview capturing Dashavidha Pariksha (Prakriti, Vikriti, Sara, Samhanana, Pramana, Satmya, Sattva, Ahara Shakti, Vyayama Shakti, Vaya) and Ahara-Vihara assessment'
_honesty_note: The ten parameter names below are taken verbatim from the official PS text. The one-line description under each is this project's own plain-language gloss, written to make the parameter askable in a patient interview - it has NOT been reviewed by anyone with Ayurvedic/BAMS training. Same labeling discipline as data/guidelines/seed_guidelines.json's STARTER_SEED entries: real enough to build and demo against, not real enough to claim clinical validity. Get a domain review before presenting any of this as more than a scaffold.

parameters.name: Prakriti
parameters.gloss: The patient's baseline constitution - which of the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) they tend toward by nature, not just right now.

parameters.name: Vikriti
parameters.gloss: The patient's current state of imbalance - how far and in what direction their present condition has shifted from their Prakriti.

parameters.name: Sara
parameters.gloss: The quality/excellence of the patient's bodily tissues (dhatus) - a general marker of tissue health and resilience.

parameters.name: Samhanana
parameters.gloss: Body build and compactness - how well-knit or loosely-built the patient's physical frame is.

parameters.name: Pramana
parameters.gloss: Body measurements and proportions relative to the patient's own frame - a proportionality assessment, not a fixed external standard.

parameters.name: Satmya
parameters.gloss: What the patient's body has adapted to and tolerates well over time - habitual diet, climate, and lifestyle factors it has grown suited to.

parameters.name: Sattva
parameters.gloss: Mental strength and resilience - the patient's capacity to withstand stress, pain, or a difficult course of treatment.

parameters.name: Ahara Shakti
parameters.gloss: Digestive capacity - how well and how much the patient can eat and properly digest.

parameters.name: Vyayama Shakti
parameters.gloss: Physical exercise capacity - how much exertion the patient can sustain before fatigue.

parameters.name: Vaya
parameters.gloss: Age-related assessment - the patient's age bracket and its bearing on treatment approach and dosage.

ahara_vihara_note: The PS also names 'Ahara-Vihara assessment' (diet and lifestyle) as part of this same extended interview - captured separately in ClinicalHistorySummary.personal_history for now rather than duplicated here, since it overlaps with the existing personal-history field CarePilot already collects.
